subject: 1093年大理国小河埠（原创建筑概化，细部待考）
prompt: Sketch-to-render. Convert the supplied precise quadrilateral INTO a thin old stone river wharf game sprite; keep its four outline corners and all edge slopes EXACTLY the same as diagram. Shape is an8m by4m rectangle on2:1 dimetric city grid, LEFT(168,430), FRONT(968,830), RIGHT(1368,630), BACK(568,230). Width/depth2.0, BOTH axes slopes+0.5/-0.5. This geometry is mandatory. Replace flat gray fill with realistic weathered gray stone paving slabs of a1093 Dali riverside landing, and remove blue border. Surface stays in that exact plane. Add only two low timber mooring posts with coiled coarse rope near the long lower-left edge, one small inset three-step landing within the same rectangle. Slab edge only20px thick, nearly flush to ground. Rear long edge from BACK to RIGHT must be perfectly straight and unobstructed for riverbank attachment. Upper-left lighting, gentle weathering and moss in a few joints. Opaque natural stone surface, genuine transparent RGBA background outside shape; no white background, colored lines, water, shore, grass, extra terrain, people, text, modern objects, logos or watermark. All margins spacious. Preserve exact geometry of supplied silhouette.
negative: 文字、现代元素、人物、房屋、瓦顶、水面、船只、景观背景、厚悬空底座、裁切

references.role: 返修生成输入；建筑候选为编辑目标，projection_guide为程序绘制的精确占地QA几何指导（非入库美术）

created_time_basis: 生成后记录的接收/归档时间；非工具披露的服务端调用时间

steps: uniform LANCZOS resize; dimensions rounded to nearest px
paste without mask into transparent RGBA canvas; no repaint, warp, flip or alpha thresholding

geometry_qa.precision_note: 人工读可见底面边；±3px不确定性；非3D测绘，隐藏后角未直接测得。

notes: 已逐张view_image检查原图与成品QA叠图；无文字、水印、现代物件和人物，完整RGBA透明留边；光源左上。河埠恢复8×4宽深关系，双轴协调；接岸背侧长边直且无遮挡，台阶内嵌，不越矩形边界。仅裁切、等比LANCZOS缩放、透明扩边；历史细部与风格仍待作者审批。
